title: Retell uses OpenAI models to help power 100M monthly calls

beats.text: Retell is now powering a staggering 100 million monthly calls using OpenAI's models.
beats.visual_focus: Hero announcement card with OpenAI emblem.

visual_blueprint.title: RETELL USES OPENAI MODELS TO HELP POWER 100M MONTHLY CALLS
visual_blueprint.sub: Hero announcement card with OpenAI emblem.

motif_params.title: RETELL USES OPENAI MODELS TO HELP POWER 100M MONTHLY CALLS
motif_params.sub: Hero announcement card with OpenAI emblem.

beats.text: For developers, the big question is scale. How do you keep voice agents efficient enough to turn a profit while maintaining quality at this volume?. Think of it like handing a teammate a checklist instead of one instruction at a time.
beats.visual_focus: Animated graph showing call volume rising.

visual_blueprint.title: SCALING VOICE AGENTS
visual_blueprint.sub: Animated graph showing call volume rising.

motif_params.title: SCALING VOICE AGENTS
motif_params.sub: Animated graph showing call volume rising.

beats.text: Retell is integrating OpenAI technology to handle this massive load. They are using Codex to boost internal productivity, reaching a revenue run rate of $1.6 million per employee.
beats.visual_focus: Screenshot of Retell dashboard with revenue metrics.

visual_blueprint.title: $1.6M REVENUE PER EMPLOYEE
visual_blueprint.sub: Screenshot of Retell dashboard with revenue metrics.

motif_params.title: $1.6M REVENUE PER EMPLOYEE
motif_params.sub: Screenshot of Retell dashboard with revenue metrics.

beats.text: Performance matters, and GPT-6 Astra is leading the pack. It officially tops Retell’s internal benchmark for voice agent capabilities, outperforming other tested alternatives.
beats.visual_focus: Benchmarking chart showing GPT-6 Astra at the top.

visual_blueprint.title: TOP-TIER PERFORMANCE
visual_blueprint.sub: Benchmarking chart showing GPT-6 Astra at the top.

motif_params.title: TOP-TIER PERFORMANCE
motif_params.sub: Benchmarking chart showing GPT-6 Astra at the top.

beats.text: It’s a serious operation. The pricing is set at $1.6, and while the exact technical architecture details remain unconfirmed, the business impact is clear.
beats.visual_focus: Overlay showing pricing icon and $1.6 figure.

visual_blueprint.title: PRICING
visual_blueprint.sub: Overlay showing pricing icon and $1.6 figure.

motif_params.title: PRICING
motif_params.sub: Overlay showing pricing icon and $1.6 figure.
